title: Live STT - a fallback provider recovered zero sessions for 6h

model.expr: sum by (to_mode) (increase(omi_fallback_total{job="backend-listen-metrics",component=~"stt_selection|stt_live_session",to_mode!="unavailable",to_mode!="vendor"}[6h])) unless on(to_mode) label_replace(max by (provider) (omi_stt_provider_retired{job="backend-listen-metrics"} == 1), "to_mode", "$1", "provider", "(.*)")

annotations.summary: A live-STT fallback leg (to_mode) had at least 50 selection or mid-session hops in 6h and recovered none of them
annotations.threshold: recovered < 1 with >= 50 stt_selection|stt_live_session attempts in 6h, per to_mode (excluding the terminal to_mode=unavailable), for 30m
annotations.user_impact: That provider is not serving live sessions. The chain may still recover via another leg; if every remaining leg is also dead, sessions exhaust (see chain-exhaustion alerts). Retired providers (omi_stt_provider_retired == 1, e.g. Deepgram) are excluded so an intentionally unfunded leg cannot page. Soniox was in this state for 27.5h on 2026-09-19/20 because recovered was recorded at connect.
annotations.scope: backend-listen omi_fallback_total component=~stt_selection|stt_live_session, grouped by to_mode. to_mode=unavailable is the no-provider-left sentinel, never a leg that can recover, so it is excluded (chain-exhaustion alerts own it). job=backend-listen-metrics Counter.
annotations.verification: Evidence layer is Cloud Logging. Deepgram: recovered=0 in both the 2026-09-18 09:00Z 5m tolerable window and the 2026-09-19 04:40-10:40Z 6h incident window; exhausted-to-deepgram was 20000+ (query cap) in that 6h. Soniox mid-session: omi_fallback_event was recorded as component=other from=modulate to=soniox outcome=recovered at connect (58 recovered alongside 42 budget closes in the 2026-09-19 16:00Z 2m window). After truthful recovery those hops are exhausted, recovered=0, so this rule would fire on to_mode=soniox. 2m budget-close/connect samples: 2026-09-19 03:00Z 30/30, 04:40Z 32/32, 2026-09-20 04:00Z 40/39 versus good 2026-09-18 09:00Z 0/16 and 2026-09-20 07:30Z 0/13. Prometheus replay 2026-10-13 (30m steps, 10 days, after excluding unavailable and retired legs): one real episode, to_mode=parakeet 10-06 13:43 to 10-07 04:13 (capacity_full exhaustion during the L4 stockout), plus two single samples.
annotations.safe_next_action: Identify the to_mode on panel 16. For budget exhaustion see panel 18 and raise the vendor cap. For Deepgram, confirm the account/handshake error in backend-listen logs; do not rotate unrelated provider keys.
annotations.evaluated_bad: to_mode=soniox: Cloud Logging proxy of the lying recovered series was 58 in 2m at 2026-09-19 16:00Z with 42 budget closes the same 2m — after the fix recovered=0 and attempts>=50 over 6h. to_mode=deepgram recovered=0, exhausted>=20000 in 2026-09-19 04:40-10:40Z. Prometheus replay 2026-10-13 confirmed (see verification).
annotations.evaluated_good: to_mode=soniox: 2026-09-18 09:00Z and 2026-09-20 after 07:30Z had 0 budget closes (0/16 and 0/13 connections); hops that transcribe would recover. to_mode=deepgram recovered=0 also in the 2026-09-18 09:00Z tolerable window — that leg has been dead through both periods, which is why the alert is the standing-failure detector. Prometheus replay 2026-10-13 confirmed (see verification).

title: Live STT - provider budget/quota exhausted (top up)

model.expr: (sum by (provider) (increase(omi_stt_stream_close_total{job="backend-listen-metrics",reason="provider_budget_exhausted"}[5m])) > 0 or max by (provider) (omi_stt_provider_circuit_open{job="backend-listen-metrics",kind="account"}) == 1) unless on (provider) (max by (provider) (omi_stt_provider_retired{job="backend-listen-metrics"} == 1))

annotations.summary: A live STT provider is out of balance or quota - top up the provider named in the alert instance labels.
annotations.threshold: budget closes increase in 5m for one provider, or that provider's account breaker is open on any pod (omi_stt_provider_circuit_open kind=account), for 2m, minus retired providers
annotations.user_impact: That provider will not serve any stream until a human tops up the balance or quota; sessions hopping onto it get no transcript. The alert stays firing for the whole account cooldown (default 30m) even while pods hold the provider out instead of re-dialing, and resolves only once the cooldown has elapsed with no fresh budget closes - i.e. after a top-up actually took effect (a successful serve or the elapsed cooldown clears the gauge).
annotations.scope: backend-listen omi_stt_stream_close_total reason=provider_budget_exhausted plus omi_stt_provider_circuit_open kind=account, grouped by provider. Retired providers (intentionally unfunded - hosted Deepgram per the 2026-09 cost ruling) are excluded via omi_stt_provider_retired so they cannot fire forever.
annotations.verification: Hermetic rule contract checked; the metric names are also asserted to be emitted in backend source. No production Prometheus evaluation or notification delivery performed.
annotations.safe_next_action: Top up the named provider (Soniox org balance, Modulate usage cap). This is a balance or monthly cap and can recur before month end. Do not rotate unrelated provider keys.
annotations.evaluated_bad: Synthetic contract: soniox with 10 budget closes in 5m fires; soniox with the account bench open (gauge=1) and zero fresh closes - pods are holding it out for the 30m cooldown - still fires; deepgram with 100 budget closes stays silent because omi_stt_provider_retired{provider="deepgram"}=1.
annotations.evaluated_good: Synthetic contract: no provider with budget closes in 5m and no open account bench (a topped-up provider clears the gauge once its cooldown elapses or a dial succeeds).

annotations.summary: The live STT demand gate is unavailable; sessions are degrading to the vendor path.
annotations.user_impact: Live STT sessions are falling back to the vendor path because the demand gate is unavailable.
annotations.threshold: Admitted cohort: omi_listen_demand_failure_detail_total{demand_cohort=admitted,reason=gate_unavailable} / admitted live sessions over 15m > 0.10 with >= 50 admitted sessions, for 15m. All-sessions guard (independent of the cohort label, so a missing label cannot hide an outage): gate_unavailable omi_fallback_total / all live sessions over 15m > 0.60 with >= 100 sessions. Baseline 2026-10-18/19 (all sessions, 15m windows): p10 9.6%, p50 23.9%, p90 50.5%, max 76.6%; that level came from demand_presence on non-admitted sessions and is no longer expected to page.
annotations.scope: backend-listen omi_listen_demand_failure_detail_total (admitted cohort) plus the omi_fallback_total all-sessions guard; to_mode=vendor is the demand-gate sentinel, not a provider.

annotations.safe_next_action: Restore the demand-gate Redis path and confirm sessions return to normal provider routing.
